title: Sesame tofu with spinach
summary: Sesame tofu with spinach is a japanese dinner built around firm tofu and baby spinach, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Have everything for Sesame tofu with spinach chopped before the pan goes on. Pat firm tofu dry and season it.
steps.tip: A short cook only works if the chopping is finished first.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook firm tofu until just done. Lift it out.
In the same pan, cook baby spinach and sesame seeds until hot and lightly browned. Return firm tofu and toss with the lemon, lime or sauce.
Taste Sesame tofu with spinach, add salt if it needs it, and serve straight away.
steps.tip: Taste Sesame tofu with spinach before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
